definitions.gloss: embarrassed smile; bashful laugh; sheepish grin
definitions.explanation: a smile or laugh that comes from feeling embarrassed, shy, or self-conscious

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{照|て}れ{笑|わら}いした。
{褒|ほ}められて{照|て}れ{笑|わら}いを{浮|う}かべた。
examples.english: She gave a bashful smile when complimented.

examples.japanese: {頭|あたま}を{掻|か}きながら{照|て}れ{笑|わら}いする{姿|すがた}がかわいい。
examples.english: The way they scratch their head while laughing bashfully is cute.

notes:
COMPOUND:
{照|て}れる (to be embarrassed) + {笑|わら}い (smile, laugh)

NUANCE:
This is generally a positive or endearing expression, suggesting modesty or shyness rather than discomfort. It often accompanies receiving praise or attention.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {照|て}れ{笑|わら}いする - to smile bashfully
- {照|て}れ{笑|わら}いを{浮|う}かべる - to wear an embarrassed smile

RELATED:
- {苦笑|にがわら}い - bitter/wry smile
- {薄笑|うすわら}い - smirk
- {愛想笑|あいそうわら}い - polite smile
